title: Austin's Future: Planning, Land, & Design
summary:
*   **Strategic Planning:** Officials discussed long-term city planning, specifically integrating economic development into comprehensive strategies.
*   **Community Land Use:** A report detailed the proposed lease of city property to the Blackland Community Development Corporation.
*   **Urban Design:** A work session was held to discuss the design for a new municipal office complex.

SPECIAL CALLED MEETINGS - FEBRUARY 11 & 12, 1986 CENTRAL LIBRARY AUDITORIUM Council
Chambers, 307 West Second Street, Austin, Texas Memorandum To:
4:00P.M.
Mayor Cooksey called to order the meeting scheduled for 4:00 on February 11, 1986, noting
the absence of Councilmember Rose.
Purpose of the meeting was to hold a work session on strategic planning, including
Economic Development Commission in the comprehensive planning process. The meeting was
adjourned at 5 p.m.
Mayor Cooksey called to order the meeting scheduled for 4:00 on February 12, 1986, noting
the presence of all Councilmembers. CITY MANAGER REPORT Paula Phillips presented a City
Manager Report on Lease of Property to the Blackland Community Development Corporation.
WORK SESSION Council held a work session on the municipal office complex design.
Transcript of work session is on file in City Clerk's office.
The meeting was adjourned at 6:20 p.m.
